[element-annex-type]
=== `<annex-type>` Type of Annex

This element acts as a flag whose content can be both interrogated and displayed. It answers the question, “Is this Annex (<<element-app,`<app>`>>) normative or informative (non-normative)?”. The element content is expected to be “`(normative)`” or “`(informative)`”.

#### Usage/Remarks
The element content is _expected_ to be “`(normative)`” or “`(informative)`”; however, other values may be needed in contexts this work does not anticipate.
Strictly speaking, this element is redundant with the appendix (<<element-app,`<app>`>>) element’s <<attribute-content-type,`@content-type`>> attribute, whose expected values are “`norm-annex`” and “`inform-annex`”. The description of the annex type in this element is intended for display to the end user, so the element should contain the text that will print/display in the formatted standard.

#### Models and Context

#### May be contained in

<<element-app,`<app>`>>
#### Description

Text, numbers, or special characters
#### Content Model

[source,xml]
....
<!ELEMENT  annex-type   (#PCDATA)                                    >
....

#### Tagged Samples

<back>

   <label>Annex A</label>

     approximately 15 % of the world population (over one billion 
     people) has ...</p>

   ...
  </app>
 </app-group>
 <ref-list>...</ref-list>
</back>
